resolution.question: Will the six university friends in the Ljubljana-trip group chat agree on dates and book the apartment before early-bird train fares end on the 15th?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that before 2026-08-15T23:59:00+02:00, all six friends have agreed on specific dates (e.g., via messages in the chat) and the apartment has been booked (e.g., a booking confirmation is shared or Jaka confirms booking). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
